captions.detailed: A realistic, highly detailed bicycle front-end assembly consisting of a fork and drop-style handlebars. The fork features a rigid rectangular crown with two tapered blades, connected to a short cylindrical head-tube stub. Mounted atop the steerer tube is a stem that clamps onto the curved drop handlebars, which are equipped with blocky brake-lever hoods and light grey lever blades. The assembly has a uniform matte black finish except for the contrasting light grey brake levers.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a bicycle fork and handlebar assembly in CadQuery. The model should include a rigid fork crown with tapered blades, a central steerer tube passing through a head tube stub, a stem, drop handlebars with curved ends, and brake lever assemblies with contrasting light-colored levers. Ensure the steering assembly is properly aligned and can rotate about the vertical steerer axis.
captions.factory: Construct the head tube using a hollow cylinder. Model the steering fork assembly by combining a vertical steerer tube, a rectangular crown box, and two tapered fork blades created via lofted or extruded profiles. Create the stem using a horizontal cylinder and a clamping block. Construct the drop handlebars using a swept circle along a multi-segment 3D path to form the characteristic curves, and add brake hoods and levers using extruded boxes positioned symmetrically on the bars.
